method: Playwright element captures, then direct image inspection. Captures are taller than the viewport and include the fixed site header at its capture position.
observations: GMM numeric controls and sliders align within the narrow lab; density curve, responsibility strip and numeric table remain available and legible.
NMF paired controls, matrix cells, saved-reference action and additive strips remain readable. Its wider numeric table is contained in its existing scrolling region.

Regularization sliders, objective plot, exact-zero interval plot and family table preserve their topic-specific representation. No new overlapping labels or stretched graph geometry were observed in these three initial views.
limitations: Three initial mobile lab views only; not an exhaustive visual review of all21topics or arbitrary control states.
The fixed navigation appears within tall element captures; page-level mobile overflow is checked separately.
